purpose: Illustrative successful terminal views selected for recognizable target objects. Laptop and Vase are additionally selected for genuine target-overlapping End-action Grad-CAM, without altering maps, gradients, checkpoints or normalization. This selection does not estimate typical localization accuracy or causal model superiority.

AlarmClock.reason: Large recognizable alarm clock in both own successful terminal views; GaWF highlight covers clock face.

HousePlant.reason: Leaves and plant pot are clearly visible in model input; no claim that its stop map is centered on the plant.

Laptop.reason: Laptop screen and keyboard visible; GaWF high-response region covers screen/hinge.

Vase.reason: Actual successful autonomous End decision; large blue vase visible and genuine positive Grad-CAM overlaps vase body.

comparison: Each model uses its own successful terminal view and history; shared episode for eleven categories, BaseballBat uses different successful episodes. Vase GaWF uses a new fixed-seed autonomous rollout; the other entries are verified validation pose replays. Visual inputs and terminal states are not held identical.
inference_boundary: No poses, maps, simulator labels or metrics enter either policy; evaluator metadata is used only for rendering and verification.
